relationships.subject: Taxol
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP-I/II peptidergic nerve fiber density was significantly decreased by about 73% in response to Taxol treatment

relationships.subject: gabapentin
relationships.evidence_quote: Gabapentin significantly conferred recovery from Taxol-induced IENF loss by increasing CGRP-I/II to about 46% of the level in the healthy mice

relationships.subject: gabapentin
relationships.evidence_quote: Gabapentin significantly conferred recovery from Taxol-induced IENF loss by increasing intra-epidermal nerve fiber density to about 83% of the healthy mice

relationships.subject: gabapentin
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings indicate that gabapentin significantly inhibited the Taxol-induced thermal allodynia in the acute thermal pain models of the hot plate and tail-flick tests.

key_findings: Gabapentin alleviated Taxol-induced allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia in mice
Taxol reduced IENF (80%) and CGRP-I/II fiber (73%) density; gabapentin restored them by 83% and 46% respectively
